name: The Office Technology Group
description: With 35 years of loyalty to our vast client base, our focus is on providing customized solutions that address our customers’ unique business needs. From impressive digital imaging to state-of-the-art digital displays, IT support, and managed print services, The Office Technology Group offers a wide variety of products and services for your company. We provide the latest technologies and services with our impressive line of products, giving your company increased efficiency, custom-designed to work with your budget.

name: HealthPartners
description:
HealthPartners is group health insurance carrier focused on the health and well-being in partnership with our members, patients, and community. 

Our insurance offers quality plans you want at a price you can manage.  We can help get the most out of your coverage whether you are covered through a Medicare plan, Individual plan or employer sponsored plan.

name: CESA Purchasing
description: CESA Purchasing provides procurement support to entities across the state of Wisconsin including public, private and charter schools, municipalities, libraries, museums, etc. We hold 150+ contracts with our vendor partners that can be utilized by purchasers to receive pre-negotiated discounted pricing. Our contracts, services and support are all completely FREE to the purchaser.

name: Baxter & Woodman
description: Founded in 1946, Baxter & Woodman, Inc. provides consulting engineering and technology services to municipalities, state agencies, county governments, and sanitary districts throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Florida, and Texas. Clients receive planning, design, construction, and operation/maintenance services for a variety of projects including transportation, wastewater, water, stormwater, GIS, operations, IT consulting and SCADA technology, and general municipal public works.

name: Architectural Design Consultants
description: ADCI is a Wisconsin-based architecture and design practice with offices in Madison, Lake Delton, and Appleton. We pair broad planning, technical design, BIM, interiors, and construction-administration capability with direct access to senior decision-makers. That structure matters on a municipal facility: questions are resolved quickly, commitments remain visible, and the people introduced in the proposal stay accountable through construction.

name: Kapur & Associates
description: Kapur is a full-service consulting engineering firm providing roadway design, capital improvement planning, water/storm/sanitary sewer design, survey, construction inspection and management, environmental services, landscape architecture, grant writing, and creating and managing TIF districts. Our corporate headquarters is in Milwaukee, with branch offices across the Midwest. Kapur has steadily grown to over 400 professionals and provides services to municipalities, DOTs, power companies, developers, railroads, water and sewer districts and school districts for over 45 years.

name: Ready Rebound
description: Ready Rebound combines sports medicine with hands-on navigation to improve the speed and quality of recovery, so workers return to duty 30% faster, and strengthen the organizations they serve.

name: Deluxe
description: Deluxe Merchant Services is a trusted leader in both payments and data-driven marketing. By combining innovative technology services with industry-leading expertise, we’ve built a robust suite of payment solutions that empower government agencies to scale efficiently, accelerate growth, and foster profitable customer connections. Whether it’s managing high-volume transactions, seamlessly integrating multiple payment sources, or transitioning into the digital economy, we make it all work smarter, faster. To accelerate your payment offering, visit https://www.deluxe.com/who-we-serve/government/.
